name: Browse Timeout Error Attribution
changes: Distinguishes errors returned by the NewzDeck backend from actual browser-to-localhost transport failures so an upstream NNTP article timeout is no longer mislabeled as a local-service outage.
Article overview HTTP timeouts and connection resets now identify the news provider as the failing subsystem while preserving the existing recover-and-continue browsing behavior.
Real localhost fetch/refused/reset/timeout failures retain local-backend guidance, and the established Automation Grab transport wording remains source-aware.
Compacts schema-9 Video decode-suppression policy reason labels to fit the existing 48-character diagnostics reason contract without truncating the policy outcome.

Preserves the accepted six-slot Video ceiling, five-request Image HTTP gate, 24 MB/12-segment Video sample bounds, 800/800/1000 headers, All Posts accumulator, settings-save retry behavior, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover, Smart Import, Automation and Metadata Server behavior.
regression_guards: HTTP response errors are never passed through the generic localhost/network translator a second time.
Only /api/articles provider timeout/reset HTTP errors receive the new provider-specific browse wording; unrelated backend HTTP detail is preserved.
Video policy reason shortening changes labels only; v3.6.71 definitive decode suppression semantics remain intact.
Browsing-performance schema remains 9 and terminal download-history schema remains 3.

Image admission stays 5, high-connection Video ceiling stays 6, Video sample bounds stay 24 MB/12 segments, headers stay 800/800/1000, All Posts wait bounds stay unchanged, and settings replacement retries remain Windows 5/32/33 for 3 seconds.
